alias.name: test_al_load
alias.description: Import an APEXlang application folder and report elapsed time.

query.sql: set define on set verify off set timing off column apexlang_path new_value apexlang_path noprint select :apexlang_path apexlang_path from dual; column started_at new_value started_at noprint select (sysdate - date '2026-01-01') * 86400 as started_at from dual; prompt Importing APEXlang application from &apexlang_path. ... apex import -input &apexlang_path. set verify off set define on select 'Elapsed time: ' || to_char( (sysdate - date '2026-01-01') * 86400 - &started_at , 'FM999999990D000') || ' seconds' as elapsed_time from dual; set define off

bind.tooltip: Path to the APEXlang application folder.

alias.name: test_sql_load
alias.description: Run an SQL script and report elapsed time.

query.sql: set define on set verify off set timing off column sql_file new_value sql_file noprint select :sql_file sql_file from dual; column started_at new_value started_at noprint select (sysdate - date '2026-01-01') * 86400 as started_at from dual; prompt Running SQL script &sql_file. ... @&sql_file. set verify off set define on select 'Elapsed time: ' || to_char( (sysdate - date '2026-01-01') * 86400 - &started_at , 'FM999999990D000') || ' seconds' as elapsed_time from dual; set define off

bind.tooltip: Path to the SQL script to run.
